summary: Family starts with two F handshapes touching at the thumbs and index fingers and circles them around to meet again on the pinky side.
movement: Hands circle outward and around to meet
steps: Make F handshapes with both hands (index finger and thumb touching, other fingers up).
Touch the hands together at the thumb side.
Circle them outward and around until the pinky sides meet.
note: This circling shape is a pattern: with C hands it's CLASS, with G hands it's GROUP, with T hands it's TEAM. The handshape names the group.
mistakes: Circling without meeting at the end. The hands start together and end together.
